# AUTO-GENERATED by tools/gen_ucm_realm_actions.py; edit there, not this file.
quarterly_playable_pulse = {
	on_actions = { ucm_law_lock_pulse }
}

ucm_law_lock_pulse = {
	trigger = {
		ucm_single_player_trigger = yes
		OR = {
			exists = var:ucm_law_lock_realm
			exists = var:ucm_law_lock_gender
		}
	}
	effect = { ucm_law_lock_enforce_effect = yes }
}

# The heir may not be a ruler yet, so enforcement decides later whether the lock applies. An heir's own lock stays.
on_death = {
	on_actions = { ucm_law_lock_pass_to_heir }
}

ucm_law_lock_pass_to_heir = {
	trigger = {
		ucm_single_player_trigger = yes
		exists = primary_heir
	}
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:ucm_law_lock_realm primary_heir = { NOT = { exists = var:ucm_law_lock_realm } } }
			primary_heir = { set_variable = { name = ucm_law_lock_realm value = root.var:ucm_law_lock_realm } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = var:ucm_law_lock_gender primary_heir = { NOT = { exists = var:ucm_law_lock_gender } } }
			primary_heir = { set_variable = { name = ucm_law_lock_gender value = root.var:ucm_law_lock_gender } }
		}
	}
}

# Whoever inherits a title under the devout elective becomes a theocracy.
on_title_gain_inheritance = {
	on_actions = { ucm_theocratic_elective_inheritance }
}

ucm_theocratic_elective_inheritance = {
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:title = { has_title_law = ucm_theocratic_elective_succession_law }
				NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_theocracy }
			}
			ucm_convert_character_to_theocracy_government_effect = yes
		}
	}
}
